2607.13621.title: UESF-Bench: Benchmarking and Probing for Unified Embodied Seeking and Following
2607.13621.paper_summary: Language-guided human following is an important capability for embodied agents, but existing benchmarks typically assume that the target person is visible at the start of an episode. This setting simplifies the problem and overlooks a more realistic requirement: an agent often needs to first find a language-described target and then persistently follow that target in a dynamic environment. While recent work has started to study human search, existing settings are typically evaluated in task-specific scenarios and often rely on stronger prior knowledge of the environment. Moreover, they usually treat searching and following as separate tasks and still lack a unified benchmark for systematic evaluation. To address these limitations, we introduce the Unified Embodied Seeking and Following Benchmark (UESF-Bench), a large-scale and diverse benchmark for embodied human seeking and following. The benchmark requires agents to handle semantic-guided exploration, reliable behavior switching and recovery, and delayed identity grounding. To this end, we propose SeekFollow-VLA, a vision-language-action framework with a task-driven routing mechanism for latent phase inference and transition modeling between seeking and following. Experimental results show that SeekFollow-VLA achieves clear improvements over both single-head and dual-head baselines across single-person and multi-person environments, establishing a baseline for unified embodied seek-and-follow.
2607.13621.paper_summary_zh: 語言引導的人類跟隨是具身代理的重要能力，但現有的基準通常假設目標人物在劇集開始時是可見的。這種設定簡化了問題，並忽略了一個更現實的需求：代理通常需要首先找到一個語言描述的目標，然後在動態環境中持續跟隨該目標。雖然最近的研究已經開始研究人類搜索，但現有的設定通常在特定任務的場景中進行評估，並且往往依賴於對環境的更強先驗知識。此外，它們通常將搜索和跟隨視為兩個獨立的任務，仍然缺乏統一的基準來進行系統評估。為了解決這些限制，我們引入了統一具身尋找和跟隨基準（UESF-Bench），這是一個大規模且多樣化的具身人類尋找和跟隨基準。該基準要求代理處理語義引導的探索、可靠的行為切換和恢復，以及延遲的身份定位。為此，我們提出了SeekFollow-VLA，一個具有任務驅動路由機制的視覺-語言-行動框架，用於潛在階段推斷和尋找與跟隨之間的轉換建模。實驗結果顯示，SeekFollow-VLA在單人和多人環境中相較於單頭和雙頭基準均取得了明顯的改進，為統一具身尋找和跟隨建立了基準。
